title: Steady-State Endurance Run - Engelbrektsloppet Base Building

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly and controlled, focus on spinal mobility and breathing rhythm. Synchronize breath with movement.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Extend opposite arm and leg fully, hold for 1 second. Keep core engaged and hips level throughout.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Move fluidly between positions, opening hips progressively. This prepares hips for sustained running effort.

items.name: Easy Jogging
items.cues: Start at conversational pace (RPE 3-4), gradually increasing heart rate. Focus on relaxed cadence and steady breathing.

items.name: Steady-State Aerobic Run
items.cues: Maintain RPE 5-6 throughout (conversational but slightly elevated breathing). Focus on consistent pace, relaxed shoulders, and efficient form. This is base-building work for 45km race preparation. Maintain steady cadence around 170-180 steps per minute. If hitting mental fatigue, break into smaller mental segments (10-minute blocks).

items.name: Easy Walking
items.cues: Walk at easy pace to gradually lower heart rate. Focus on deep breathing to promote parasympathetic recovery.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Hold each leg for 1 minute. Keep heel down and lean forward gently. Focus on breathing and relaxation.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place forearm against wall at shoulder height, gently rotate body away. Hold each side for 1 minute. This counterbalances running posture.

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Slow, controlled movements to gently decompress the spine after sustained running effort. Emphasize relaxation and recovery breathing.

rationale: 20 days to Engelbrektsloppet 45km requires consistent aerobic base building at RPE 5-6; this steady-state run develops fatigue resistance for ultra-distance event
Recent training shows excellent recovery status with 'great' feedback - this endurance session maintains momentum while respecting training load with moderate intensity
Structured 45-minute main set with proper warm-up and recovery protocol optimizes parasympathetic adaptation and prepares body for race-specific demands
